decisions.record: The tools convert quantities whose units do not conform
decisions.inputs: integrationtime='10Jy', integrationtime='10m' or freq='1s' passed to a simulator method; a direction string such as 'J2000 12h00m00 garbage'.
decisions.casa: CASA 6.7.6 converts without checking conformance: '10Jy' becomes 1e-25 s, '10m' 10 s, '1s' 1 Hz, and an unreadable direction token keeps the previous value (declination 180 deg).
decisions.ours: Refuses both with casacore's 'From/to units not consistent' or a parse error, while keeping CASA's cross-dimension conversions (number is SI, angle is time, length is frequency via c).
decisions.rationale: Non-conforming units are almost certainly user errors and should not become silent wrong values.
decisions.impact: Scripts with a wrong unit now stop with an error instead of running with a nonsense value.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

signature.scope: CASA 6.7.6.14's methods, names and defaults, and the object-surface bundle's; not behavior.

refusals.scope: Each method casa-rs does not implement raises NotImplementedError naming #1053.

casa-values.result: 96 of the 131 tests pass against CASA 6.7.6.14's own qa tool: every test of a value or a raised message. The 35 others test what only casa-rs has (its refusals, bundle and import) or one message CASA writes to its own log; the receipt classifies each. casa-rs passes the same tests in CI.
